en.headline: Netanyahu and Eisenkot parties conclude coalition talks without agreement
en.body: The parties of Benjamin Netanyahu and Gadi Eisenkot ended a round of coalition negotiations on 23 November without reaching a deal. Both sides stated they outlined their positions on substantive issues and discussed them in detail.

es.headline: Partidos de Netanyahu y Eisenkot concluyen negociaciones de coalición sin acuerdo
es.body: Los partidos de Benjamin Netanyahu y Gadi Eisenkot finalizaron una ronda de negociaciones de coalición el 23 de noviembre sin llegar a un acuerdo. Ambas partes declararon haber expuesto sus posturas sobre cuestiones sustantivas y haberlas discutido en detalle.

it.headline: I partiti di Netanyahu ed Eisenkot concludono i colloqui di coalizione senza accordo
it.body: I partiti di Benjamin Netanyahu e Gadi Eisenkot hanno concluso un ciclo di negoziati di coalizione il 23 novembre senza raggiungere un accordo. Entrambe le parti hanno dichiarato di aver delineato le proprie posizioni su questioni sostanziali e di averle discusse in dettaglio.

fr.headline: Les partis de Netanyahou et Eisenkot concluent les pourparlers de coalition sans accord
fr.body: Les partis de Benjamin Netanyahou et Gadi Eisenkot ont terminé une série de négociations de coalition le 23 novembre sans parvenir à un accord. Les deux parties ont déclaré avoir exposé leurs positions sur les questions substantielles et les avoir discutées en détail.

de.headline: Netanyahu- und Eisenkot-Parteien schließen Koalitionsgespräche ohne Einigung ab
de.body: Die Parteien von Benjamin Netanyahu und Gadi Eisenkot beendeten am 23. November eine Runde von Koalitionsverhandlungen ohne eine Einigung zu erzielen. Beide Seiten gaben an, ihre Positionen zu substanziellen Fragen dargelegt und diese detailliert erörtert zu haben.

zh.headline: 内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特政党会谈结束但未达成协议
zh.body: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡和加迪·艾森科特（Gadi Eisenkot）的政党于11月23日结束了一轮联合政府谈判，但未能达成协议。双方均表示，他们阐述了在实质性问题上的立场并进行了详细讨论。

pt.headline: Partidos de Netanyahu e Eisenkot concluem negociações de coligação sem acordo
pt.body: Os partidos de Benjamin Netanyahu e Gadi Eisenkot terminaram uma ronda de negociações de coligação a 23 de novembro sem chegar a um acordo. Ambas as partes declararam que delinearam as suas posições sobre questões substanciais e discutiram-nas em detalhe.

ko.headline: 네타냐후 및 아이젠코트 정당, 합의 없이 연정 협상 마무리
ko.body: 벤야민 네타냐후와 가디 아이젠코트 정당은 11월 23일 연정 협상 한 차례를 마무리했으나 합의에 이르지 못했다. 양측은 실질적인 쟁점에 대한 입장을 제시하고 이를 상세히 논의했다고 밝혔다.

ja.headline: ネタニヤフ氏とアイゼンコット氏の党、合意なく連立交渉を終結
ja.body: ベンヤミン・ネタニヤフ氏とガディ・アイゼンコット氏の党は、11月23日に一連の連立交渉を終えたが、合意には至らなかった。両側は、実質的な問題に関する立場を提示し、詳細に議論したと述べた。

en.title: Netanyahu and Eisenkot parties conclude coalition talks without agreement
en.dek: Negotiations between Benjamin Netanyahu's and Gadi Eisenkot's parties ended on 23 November without forming a coalition.
facts: Netanyahu and Eisenkot parties concluded coalition talks on 23 November 2026 without reaching an agreement
Both sides stated they outlined their positions on substantive issues and discussed them in detail
The talks aimed to form an Israel government following recent elections
No deal was reached despite detailed discussions on key issues
Both parties confirmed the conclusion of negotiations without a coalition pact
The outcome leaves the process of government formation ongoing
body: Netanyahu and Eisenkot parties concluded coalition talks on 23 November without reaching a deal, according to The Hindu and The Japan Times.
Both sides stated they outlined their positions on substantive issues and discussed them in detail, as reported by The Hindu.
The negotiations were part of ongoing efforts to form an Israel government following recent electoral results.
Neither party issued a joint statement confirming cooperation, with both confirming the talks ended without agreement.
The conclusion of talks means the process of forming a coalition government remains unresolved.
Political analysts noted the significance of the breakdown between the two party factions.
en.context: Coalition talks are a standard part of Israel's parliamentary system following elections, requiring parties to negotiate agreements to secure a majority in the Knesset. The involvement of Netanyahu's faction and Eisenkot's party represents a notable alignment in the current political landscape.
